name: AZ-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's D+13 partisan lean in a heavily Democratic seat
Grijalva's large fundraising and cash advantage over Butierez
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly Democratic: a D+13 lean, a Democratic environment, and incumbency for Adelita Grijalva, who has raised over $2.2 million to Daniel Butierez's $224k and holds a huge cash edge. Markets price a Democratic win at 99%, and no evidence in the dossier suggests an upset.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or a major outside-spending surge for Butierez would be the signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Adelita Grijalva, the Democratic incumbent in this heavily Democratic southern Arizona district, is favored to hold the seat she inherited through a special election. The district's D+13 partisan lean, a favorable national environment for Democrats, and her incumbency all point the same direction.

She has also dominated the money race, raising roughly ten times what Republican Daniel Butierez has and keeping a large cash-on-hand advantage, while outside spending has been minimal. Prediction markets price a Democratic win near certainty, and no polls or expert ratings in the record suggest vulnerability. The main uncertainty is simply the absence of local polling, which keeps the error band moderately wide.
